welcome.subject: Welcome to rippr ✦
welcome.preheader: Hey Alex, welcome to rippr. Discover Pokémon packs, check the odds, and keep your favorite pulls in one place.

pack-receipt.subject: Your latest pulls are in ✦
pack-receipt.preheader: Hey Alex, your Plus pack opening is complete. Here is your purchase summary.

shipping-request.subject: Shipping request RIP-10482 received
shipping-request.preheader: Hey Alex, we received your shipping request. We’ll update your order tracking when its status changes.

order-shipped.subject: Your cards are on the move — RIP-10482
order-shipped.preheader: Hey Alex, your order has been marked as shipped. Follow its journey using the tracking details below.

order-delivered.subject: Your delivery has arrived — RIP-10482
order-delivered.preheader: Hey Alex, your order has been marked as delivered. We hope you enjoy your new cards.

reward-earned.subject: Your rippr reward is ready ✦
reward-earned.preheader: Hey Alex, you earned Basic pack. It has been added to your account.

referral-earned.subject: Your invite earned a reward ✦
referral-earned.preheader: Hey Alex, a referral met the reward requirements. Your referral reward has been added to your account.

support-received.subject: We received your message — RIP-10482
support-received.preheader: Hey Alex, your support request is saved. You can view the conversation and add details from your account.

support-reply.subject: An update on your support request — RIP-10482
support-reply.preheader: Hey Alex, there’s a new reply to your support request.

closure-requested.subject: Your rippr closure request
closure-requested.preheader: Hey Alex, we received your sandbox account closure request. Your public collection is hidden and new account activity is paused.

closure-completed.subject: Your rippr account is closed
closure-completed.preheader: Your sandbox account closure has completed. The sign-in identity and original uploaded profile images were removed, and profile, address, email and birth-date data were redacted from the active account records covered by this workflow.
